column3: Close to the Hebrew; “I trust” is rendered “I believe.”
Close to the Hebrew; “They have smeared falsehood on me” is rendered “have forged a lie against me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Insensitive like fat” is rendered “covered with fat.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “pieces” (“gold and silver pieces”).
Close to the Hebrew; “I have hoped” is rendered “I wait.”
Close to the Hebrew; “My being is exhausted” is rendered “My soul languishes.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “with longing” to “My eyes fail.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “Though,” and “skin-bottle” is rendered “wineskin.”
The Hebrew says “pits which are not according to your law”; NASB applies the clause to people (“Men who are not in accord with Your law”).
Close to the Hebrew; “[Are] faithfulness” is rendered “are faithful.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Like a little” is rendered “almost.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Standing firm” is rendered “settled.”
